Please RSVP and let us know if you can come by **October 5th 2026** by following [this link](https://shorturl.at/WwHap) and entering the code from your invitation.

Please do this even if we already know you are coming, so we have the right numbers for the catering company etc.

[comment]:* If you have lost the code, there is an option to search using your name.

* If you RSVP and then change your mind about something, please RSVP again - we'll use the most recent. 
* If something changes after Oct 5th, please message or email one of us and let us know.
